long_biography.plain_text:
Moscow Raceway gave Rustem Teregulov's interest in competitive driving a permanent institutional form. After Russia's temporary circuit venues disappeared, he backed an international-standard track near Volokolamsk and commissioned Hermann Tilke to design it. The facility opened in 2012, hosting touring-car, motorcycle and endurance series. Teregulov also raced there, sharing a podium in a four-hour endurance event.

His property activities supplied the land and financial base for that project. Teregulov had acquired agricultural land rights around Moscow before developing offices through Big City. Its structures created the Arma business quarter near Kursky station, converting buildings from a nineteenth-century gasworks into a substantial commercial complex. The project opened in 2007, several years after property had become the central focus of his investment activity.
